title: Max-Tracking Queue
statement:
Design a FIFO queue of integers that can report its current maximum quickly.

Contract
- `new Solution()` creates an empty queue.
- `enqueue(value)` appends `value` at the back.
- `dequeue()` removes and returns the oldest value. Throw `NoSuchElementException` when the queue is empty.
- `max()` returns the largest value currently in the queue. Throw `NoSuchElementException` when the queue is empty.
- Each operation should run in O(1) amortized time.

Examples
- After `enqueue 3`, `enqueue 1`, `enqueue 5`, `max` returns `5`; `dequeue` returns `3`; `max` still returns `5`.
- After `enqueue 4`, `enqueue 4`, `dequeue`, `max` returns `4` because the second copy remains.
- Calling `max` on a new queue throws `NoSuchElementException`.

examples.input: enqueue 3, enqueue 1, enqueue 5, max, dequeue, max

hints: Keep the real FIFO order in one deque.
Keep a second deque of candidates in decreasing order; values smaller than a new value can never become maximum later.
When dequeuing, remove the front candidate only if it equals the dequeued value. Intended complexity: O(1) amortized per operation, O(n) for n operations.
inputSyntax: Input: operations separated by commas, for example: enqueue 3, enqueue 1, enqueue 5, max, dequeue, max
